card: Adds a `-walletrebroadcast` configuration option to decouple periodic wallet transaction rebroadcasts from initial transaction broadcasts. Currently, rebroadcasting unconfirmed transactions every 12 to 36 hours leaks wallet origin to peers, and users have no way to disable this without turning off initial broadcasting entirely. The PR changes default wallet behavior by setting `-walletrebroadcast` to false for privacy.
evidence: PR description: "Rebroadcasting transactions that are already known to the network reveals that the wallet is related to them. The way this is done (periodically send to everybody) could have bad implications for privacy, depending on other configuration options... The new `-walletrebroadcast` is introduced with a default to `false`, which is a change in the default behavior."
problem: Periodic rebroadcasting of unconfirmed wallet transactions (run every 12 to 36 hours to connected peers) links those transactions back to the node, degrading privacy. Users could not disable these recurring rebroadcasts without also disabling initial transaction broadcasting via `-walletbroadcast`.

risk.why: Changing default rebroadcast behavior to false could cause unconfirmed transactions that fall out of peer mempools to remain unconfirmed indefinitely unless rebroadcast or fee-bumped by the user.

scope_notes: The diff was not provided in the PR data.
summary: Introduces a `-walletrebroadcast` configuration option to control recurring wallet transaction rebroadcasts independently from initial broadcasts. Rebroadcasting is set to default to `false`, changing the default wallet behavior to prevent periodic announcements of unconfirmed transactions.
uncertainties: The patch diff and file list are omitted, preventing verification of implementation details and interaction with other wallet/p2p broadcast mechanisms.
